qualifier: dendrite branching and postsynaptic density maintenance
name: Dendrite branching and postsynaptic actin structural plasticity
rationale: All members concern structural remodeling of dendrites and the actin-based postsynapse; unlike confusables (filopodia, RHOF/EPHB, NMDAR-RAC1, synaptic translation) the theme adds dendrite arborization and postsynaptic density structure maintenance.

qualifier: NGF-TRKA and p75NTR survival and death branches
name: NGF-TRKA and p75NTR survival and death signalling
rationale: Members cover NGF processing, TRKA activation and its effector cascades plus p75NTR/dependence-receptor death signalling, which distinguishes the theme from NTRK2/NTRK3 (BDNF/NT-3) confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate transport and CO2 hydration
rationale: All members involve bicarbonate generation or transport for pH control (carbonic anhydrase, SLC4A1/SLC4A4 and their renal tubular acidosis defects), unlike SLC26, phosphate or V-ATPase acidification confusables.

qualifier: viral budding and multivesicular body formation
name: ESCRT-driven viral budding and multivesicular body formation
rationale: Members share ESCRT-dependent outward membrane budding (HIV/Gag budding, MVB formation, exosome release, membrane fission), distinct from ESCRT-III roles in abscission and nuclear envelope sealing or receptor downregulation.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC de novo folding of nascent proteins
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin de novo folding of nascent proteins
rationale: Members centre on CCT/TRiC folding of newly synthesized substrates (actin, tubulin intermediates, complex assembly, stabilization), lacking the prefoldin transfer, post-chaperonin tubulin, ER folding and aggregate-handling members of confusables.

name: RUNX, AP-2 and HOX lineage transcription factor programmes
rationale: All members are transcriptional programmes of developmental/lineage transcription factors (RUNX1-3 targets, TFAP2 family, Hox cluster modules); AP-2 and Hox members separate it from RUNX1 megakaryocyte/granulopoiesis confusables.

name: Endothelial differentiation and arteriovenous blood vessel formation
rationale: Members cover endothelial differentiation, vasculogenesis and arterial/venous/aortic vessel morphogenesis and maturation, distinct from lymphatic, coronary/cardiac and pulmonary-BMP vascular confusables.

qualifier: type 2 mast cell and eosinophil allergic immunity
name: Cytokine signalling and type 2 mast cell-eosinophil allergic immunity
rationale: Members span interleukin/interferon JAK-STAT signalling and Th2, FcERI mast cell, eosinophil and IgE hypersensitivity responses, broader than confusables focused on T cell activation, IL-17/IL-36 or wound-related NK T responses.

name: Gastrulation mesoderm formation and early heart field specification
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, gastrulation EMT and mesendoderm/mesoderm specification leading into cardiogenesis and secondary heart field, unlike confusables on heart tube, lateral plate, endoderm or gut.

name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis and lactate fermentation
rationale: Members concern fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and its lactate/fermentation output, separating it from F1,6BP, pentose phosphate, glycogen and hexokinase confusables.

name: Melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis in pigmentation
rationale: Members cover melanosome/pigment granule and platelet dense granule biogenesis with cargo-loading coats and melanin synthesis, distinct from lysosomal acidification, UV melanocyte responses and Golgi-lysosome vesicle confusables.

qualifier: RHOBTB, Ral and Rho effector GTPase regulation
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly-reassembly and small GTPase regulation
rationale: Members combine Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and positioning with small GTPase cycles (RHOBTB1-3, Ral, Rhotekin/KTN1), unlike confusables built on Golgi vesicle budding, tubulation and Rab/ARF trafficking.

name: Gonad, reproductive tract, mammary and pancreatic gland development
rationale: Members cover development of gonads/sex determination, reproductive tract, prostate, mammary, pancreatic and adrenal glands, separating it from lung, kidney and salivary branching-morphogenesis confusables.

name: Platelet VWF-GPIb-IX-V adhesion, activation and degranulation
rationale: Members concern platelet adhesion via VWF/GPIb-IX-V to collagen, activation, degranulation and coagulation, while confusables emphasize ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin and GPVI receptor signalling.

name: Solute carrier transport of carnitine, carboxylates and fuel metabolites
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of organic anions and fuels (carnitine, di/tricarboxylates, malate-aspartate shuttle, GLUT1, lipids across BBB), distinct from glutamate/nitrogen, PDH/TCA and cationic amino acid confusables.

qualifier: MHC class II and exogenous cross-presentation
name: Peptide antigen processing for MHC II and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover peptide antigen processing via MHC class II and phagosomal/endosomal cross-presentation to MHC I, unlike lipid/CD1 and TLR7 confusables or the classical endogenous MHC I loading confusable.

qualifier: regulation of sprouting and projection regeneration
name: Regulation of axon collateral sprouting and regenerative outgrowth
rationale: All members regulate collateral sprouting or neuron projection regeneration, distinct from semaphorin/ephrin guidance, injury-induced regrowth and axon extension confusables.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide metabolism and reactive nitrogen species
name: Hydrogen peroxide metabolism and nitrosative stress responses
rationale: Members concern hydrogen peroxide production, catabolism and response plus responses to nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen species, unlike ROS detoxification, ferroptosis and oxidative apoptosis confusables.

core: Lipid modification of proteins and glycolipid synthesis
name: GPI anchoring, protein palmitoylation and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, cysteine palmitoylation and Hedgehog lipidation, plus glycosphingolipid synthesis, combining what the confusables split (glycolipid transport vs Hh/RAS processing).

qualifier: auditory and vestibular hair cell mechanosensation
name: Ear morphogenesis and auditory-vestibular hair cell mechanosensation
rationale: Members span inner, middle and outer ear morphogenesis, hair cell specification and stereocilia, hearing and balance, distinct from cranial nerve/olfactory, eye and microvillus confusables.

qualifier: oocyte piRNA transposon silencing and maternal mRNA clearance
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and oocyte piRNA transposon silencing
rationale: Members cover oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation and zygotic epigenetic programming with piRNA silencing, distinct from male germline/spermatogenesis and general mRNA-decay confusables.

name: Vascular wound healing, remodeling and endothelial activation
rationale: Members regulate vessel remodeling, vascular wound healing, endothelial activation, proliferation and apoptosis, distinct from leukocyte-adhesion, VEGF-production, smooth muscle phenotypic switching and angiogenesis confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose homeostasis
name: LXR, PPARalpha and SREBP control of lipid-glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members concern nuclear receptor and SREBP/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of triglyceride, fatty acid and gluconeogenic metabolism, unlike adipocyte differentiation (PPARG) and circadian confusables.

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signalling to CREB
rationale: All members describe adenylate cyclase-generated cAMP activating PKA and CREB, distinct from calcium/CaMK-CREB and MECP2 confusables and from cAMP synthesis/PDE turnover confusables.

qualifier: fate specification, proliferation and oligodendrocyte differentiation
name: Glial fate specification, proliferation and oligodendrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, proliferation, migration and oligodendrocyte/astrocyte differentiation, distinct from CNS myelin formation/gliosis and Bergmann glia/midbrain neuron confusables.
